metadata.description: Shared AI Skills by Development Seed

plugins.name: github-issue-to-markdown
plugins.description: Exports a GitHub Issue (including comments and private issues) to a clean Markdown file using the GitHub CLI (`gh`). Use when asked to archive, export, or save a GitHub issue.

plugins.name: veda-story-creator
plugins.description: Generates VEDA scrollytelling story MDX files with satellite data visualizations. Use when the user wants to create a new data story, write a story about an earth science topic, or generate an MDX file for the stories directory.

plugins.name: devseed-poster
plugins.description: Creates Development Seed conference posters as self-contained HTML files — design system, layout patterns, QR codes, and PDF export

plugins.name: setup-python-repo
plugins.description: Scaffold CI/CD, linting, and dependency automation for a Python project using GitHub Actions

plugins.name: session-handoffs
plugins.description: End-of-day wrap-up for several Claude Code sessions: reads every session's transcript to see which ones left a current handoff note and lists the notes under "For Tomorrow" in your daily note; on request asks one session or writes a note from its transcript. Never waits, safe to re-run. Use for /session-handoffs or when asked to wrap up all sessions.
